Warfarin Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics

Source: R/data.R
warfarin.Rd

Plasma concentration of warfarin (cp, mg/L) and prothrombin complex activity (pca, percent of normal) in 32 subjects after one oral dose at time 0. The four concentrations recorded as 0, at 0.5 h, are left out; their limit of quantification is not known.

Format

A data frame with 479 rows, one per reading, and 10 columns:

name

"cp" or "pca".

time

hours after the dose.

value

the reading.

sigma

NA throughout.

condition

the subject, "ID1" to "ID33" without "ID11".

id

the subject, 1 to 33 without 11.

dose

the oral dose in mg.

wt, age, sex

weight (kg), age (years) and sex.

Source

Package nlmixr2data, data set warfarin (GPL >= 3), after Funaki T, Holford N, Fujita S (2018), Population PKPD analysis using nlmixr2 and NONMEM, PAGJA 2018.

O'Reilly RA, Aggeler PM, Leong LS (1963), Studies on the coumarin anticoagulant drugs: the pharmacodynamics of warfarin in man. Journal of Clinical Investigation 42(10):1542-1551.

O'Reilly RA, Aggeler PM (1968), Studies on coumarin anticoagulant drugs: initiation of warfarin therapy without a loading dose. Circulation 38:169-177.

See also

The example project Theophylline, warfarin and mavoglurant fits a PK/PD model.

Examples

data(warfarin)
head(warfarin)
#>   name time value sigma condition id dose   wt age  sex
#> 1   cp    1   1.9    NA       ID1  1  100 66.7  50 male
#> 2   cp    2   3.3    NA       ID1  1  100 66.7  50 male
#> 3   cp    3   6.6    NA       ID1  1  100 66.7  50 male
#> 4   cp    6   9.1    NA       ID1  1  100 66.7  50 male
#> 5   cp    9  10.8    NA       ID1  1  100 66.7  50 male
#> 6   cp   12   8.6    NA       ID1  1  100 66.7  50 male
